subject: Customer request: purge prompts/outputs/logs for Finly — execution plan and confirmation
messages:
From: Jared Liu <jared.liu@finly.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finly Security <security@finly.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: purge all prompt/input/output artifacts + inference logs for EU residency accounts

Hi Evelyn,

Per our compliance review, Finly needs Redwood to remove all stored prompts, model outputs, and inference logs tied to our EU tenant (finly-eu-01). This covers:
- Prompt text and metadata (past 14 months)
- Generated outputs and completion logs
- KV cache snapshots and ephemeral traces we store for debugging
- Inference-level logs (request/response traces) that include PII extracted by models

Our legal team requires an ops-run audit artifact after the purge (list of deleted object ids + job id + 1-line hash). Can you confirm timeline and what data you will (and will not) delete? We need completion confirmation before our next audit on 2026-12-10.

Thanks,
Jared
Sr. Security Engineer | Finly Payments
[Finly Security - external]
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Liu <jared.liu@finly.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: purge all prompt/input/output artifacts + inference logs for EU residency accounts

Hi Jared — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. High-level plan: 

1) Scope confirmation (Evelyn/Rishi): We will enumerate objects by tenant tag finly-eu-01 and exclude any artifacts already covered by retention policy exceptions (e.g., compliance-archival snapshots you previously requested).
2) Dry run (no-destructive): run a discovery job to produce a candidate deletion manifest for your review.
3) Execution window: schedule destructive purge during EU off-hours (target: 2026-12-02 02:00–04:00 UTC) to minimize latency impact.
4) Post-run audit: attach a compressed audit file with object ids, deletion timestamps, and SHA256 checksums of the manifests.

We need two items from you before we proceed:
- Confirmation that finly-eu-01 is the complete scope (no additional tenant aliases).
- An authorized acceptance email from a Finly approver to proceed with destructive purge.

I'll coordinate Ops (Marissa) to kick off the discovery job once we have the confirmation.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform
From: Jared Liu <jared.liu@finly.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finly Security <security@finly.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 13:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: purge all prompt/input/output artifacts + inference logs for EU residency accounts

Evelyn — confirmed. finly-eu-01 is the sole tenant for EU production. Approver note: I approve the purge on behalf of Finly Security (Jared Liu). You have authorization to proceed with the destructive purge once the discovery manifest is accepted.

Please share the discovery manifest as a GDrive link and mark it confidential.

-Jared
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Liu <jared.liu@finly.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 02:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: purge all prompt/input/output artifacts + inference logs for EU residency accounts

Hello Jared — this is Marissa from Ops. We completed the discovery run and attached a review manifest to the shared drive (see link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Finly/MA-Deletion-Checklist-2026-12-01). The manifest contains 4,312 object ids spanning prompts, outputs, and inference logs (manifest id: MAN-20261202-48).

Planned execution: 2026-12-02 02:00–02:18 UTC (fast-pass delete by tenant tag). Job id: OPS-1124.

What we will delete: full prompt text, generated outputs, inference request/response logs, KV cache snapshots created by the serving runtime for finly-eu-01.
What we will NOT delete: archived compliance snapshots stored in long-term cold storage explicitly labeled FINLY_ARCHIVE (those were requested previously by your team).

Attachments (preview only):
- MANIFEST_PREVIEW.csv (attached) — first 100 ids
- deletion-procedure-checklist.txt (attached) — ops steps and rollback checks

Please reply with a single-line approval to proceed and we will run the job in the scheduled window.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MANIFEST_PREVIEW.csv — text/csv]
[Attachment: deletion-procedure-checklist.txt — text/plain]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Liu <jared.liu@finly.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: purge all prompt/input/output artifacts + inference logs for EU residency accounts — Execution Complete

Jared / Finly Security — job OPS-1124 completed successfully. Summary: deleted 4,312 objects associated with finly-eu-01. Execution window: 2026-12-02 02:03:25–02:14:09 UTC.

Audit artifact attached: deletion-audit-20261202.jsonl.gz (contains object ids, deletion timestamps, and SHA256 of the manifest chunks). For quick verification we also attached a run snapshot (job-run-snapshot-OPS-1124.png).

Key notes:
- KV cache eviction and underlying disk blobs were removed; however, any customer-provided backups outside Redwood custody (e.g., Finly-exported snapshots) are out of scope.
- We retained the job metadata (job id, execution timestamps) in our internal ops audit logs for 90 days to support troubleshooting and compliance requests.

Please confirm receipt and state whether you need additional signed evidence (we can produce a PGP-signed manifest on request).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
